pages.title: Virtual Graviton
pages.text: A quantum of gravity that has not decided to exist yet, flickering between being and not being. It pulls faintly on everything near it, and then on nothing. Nobody has ever detected a real graviton; this one is not quite real.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Vacuum Drifters in the Quantum Foam dropped these when killed. The Vacuum Fluctuation Harvester let me catch more from between Casimir plates, cooled with superfluid helium.

Made in $(item)Vacuum Fluctuation Harvester$().$(br2)$(thing)Mined$(): from $(item)Ephemeral Graviton Ore$(), in veins through the Quantum Foam.$(br2)$(thing)Dropped by$(): Vacuum Drifter.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Quantum Foam.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Graviton Crystal, Miniature Black Hole, Miniature Wormhole.
